routes.name: Visa-free short stay
routes.summary: Citizens of countries on Albania's visa-exempt list can enter without a visa. Check the official country table for your passport.

other: Nationals of countries that are visa-free for the Schengen area can enter visa-free.
Also visa-free: holders of a valid multiple-entry Schengen, EU, US or UK visa (must have been used before) or a valid Schengen, EU, US or UK residence permit. Leave at least 3 days before it expires.
Holders of a UAE residence permit with at least 10 years validity and 1 year left on arrival.
Saudi and Qatari citizens: visa-free for tourism 15 Apr 2026 to 31 Dec 2026.
Iranian citizens always need a visa.
Passport valid 3 months past departure and issued in the last 10 years.
Border may ask for ALL 5,000 per day (adults) or ALL 2,500 per day (minors) in funds, a return ticket and proof of accommodation.
Exact stay length per nationality was not on the page we could read. See the official country table.
Fees and the nationality-by-nationality list were not on the pages we could read.

stay.note: Length depends on nationality. Check the official table.

sources.label: Albania MFA: visa regime for foreigners
Albania MFA: check if you need a visa

routes.name: US citizens: visa-free up to one year
routes.summary: US citizens can enter without a visa and stay up to one year without a residence permit.

other: Passport valid at least 3 months from arrival with one blank page.
After a year you must apply for a residence permit at the Border and Migration Police office for your area.

stay.note: No residence permit needed for the first year.

sources.label: US State Department: Albania country information

routes.name: Type C short-stay visa
routes.summary: Short-stay visa for nationals who are not visa-exempt. Good for up to 90 days in any 180 days. Apply on the e-Visa portal or at an Albanian embassy.

other: Nationals not in the visa table apply at the nearest Albanian embassy or consulate.
Multiple-entry visas of 6 months, 1, 2 or 5 years need proof of regular travel and good use of earlier visas.
Group visa: single entry, 5 to 50 people, up to 30 days.
Fees and the nationality-by-nationality list were not on the pages we could read.

steps: Check the official table to see if your passport needs a visa.
Apply on e-visa.al or at an Albanian diplomatic mission.
Bring documents proving purpose, accommodation, funds and return travel.
documents: Passport valid 3 months past visa expiry, with 2 blank pages
Proof of accommodation or host invitation

sources.label: Law 79/2021 On Aliens (English, Ministry of Interior)
Albania MFA: visa regime for foreigners

routes.name: Airport transit visa (Type A)
routes.summary: Type A lets you stay only in the international transit area of an airport until your next flight. Some categories are exempt. Type C transit visas are capped at 5 days.

other: Multiple-entry Type A visas can run up to 6 months with proof of need.
Need proof you can enter your final destination.
Who is exempt is set in the law and the visa table. Check your passport on the official table.

stay.note: Type C transit stay capped at 5 days. Type A covers airside only.

sources.label: Law 79/2021 On Aliens (English, Ministry of Interior)
Albania MFA: visa regime for foreigners

routes.name: Type D long-stay visa
routes.summary: Long-stay visa for stays over 90 days when your residence permit type needs a visa first. Valid one year. You apply for the residence permit after you arrive.

other: Only needed where the permit route requires a visa. Some passports, like US, EU and Kosovo, may not need it.
Procedure is set by a Council of Ministers decision we did not read.
Fees and the nationality-by-nationality list were not on the pages we could read.

stay.note: Covers 90 days within 180 days on entry, then you apply for the permit.

sources.label: Law 79/2021 On Aliens (English, Ministry of Interior)
Albania MFA: visa regime for foreigners

routes.name: Unique Permit: employment and self-employment
routes.summary: One permit that covers both residence and work. Covers general employment, self-employment, highly skilled workers, intra-company transfers, investors and seasonal work.

other: Need a valid travel document, a valid reason to stay under Law 79/2021, enough income for living costs and accommodation, and no security or health threat.
Employer needs approval from the National Agency for Employment and Skills. There is an annual quota set by the government.
Permit becomes invalid after 6 consecutive months abroad.
No income amounts or fees were listed on the pages we read.

stay.note: Validity options: 1, 2, 3, 5 years or permanent. First permit is usually capped at 1 year.

routes.processing: Official page says up to 12 weeks. The law says 4 to 12 weeks.
steps: Get a job offer or business plan.
Apply through e-Albania or at the regional migration police office.
Pay the fee at a second-level bank and upload documents.
Post the printed documents within 7 days of the acceptance notice.
documents: Two passport photos from the last 6 months

sources.label: e-Albania: Unique Permit application info
Law 79/2021 On Aliens (English, Ministry of Interior)

routes.name: Seasonal work permit
routes.summary: Single permit for seasonal work with an Albanian employer. Valid 6 months per calendar year, then a mandatory 6-month break before renewing.

other: Not open to EU and Schengen nationals.
Worker must go home when the contract ends.
No family reunification for seasonal workers.
Employer needs approval and quotas apply.

stay.note: 6 months per year, with a 6 month break before the next one.

sources.label: Law 79/2021 On Aliens (English, Ministry of Interior)

routes.name: Blue AL Card (highly qualified workers)
routes.summary: Permit for highly skilled workers. Two years, renewable for three years. Holders must report job changes.

other: If the employment approval is under 2 years, the card lasts the approval term plus 3 months.
Not open to people with pending asylum, researchers, or those entering under an investment commitment.
Salary and degree thresholds were not on the page we read.

sources.label: Law 79/2021 On Aliens (English, Ministry of Interior)

routes.name: Self-employed permit
routes.summary: For people starting their own business in Albania. A committee checks the economic benefit and your capital. Valid for the planned business time, up to 3 years.

other: Need an economic interest, likely positive economic impact and capital for the business.
After 3 years you may get a permanent permit if the business worked and income is enough.
Capital amount was not on the page we read.

sources.label: Law 79/2021 On Aliens (English, Ministry of Interior)

routes.name: Investor residence permit
routes.summary: Two-year permit for investors, renewable for three years. Permanent residence can follow after the second three-year permit.

other: Business must employ one foreigner per five Albanian nationals, management included.
Wages must be at least last year's average for the same jobs.
Minimum investment is set by a joint instruction we did not read.

sources.label: Law 79/2021 On Aliens (English, Ministry of Interior)

routes.name: Digital nomad (mobile worker) permit
routes.summary: One-year single permit for remote workers whose employer or clients are abroad. Written as 'digital mobile worker' in the law.

other: Valid work or service contract with a foreign employer or client with no physical HQ in Albania.
Sufficient income (no amount stated in the law).
Proof of accommodation and an Albanian address.
Health insurance valid at least 1 year.
Criminal record certificate from your home country.
US citizens can stay a year visa-free before needing a permit.

routes.processing: Law says 4 to 12 weeks for single permits.

sources.label: Law 79/2021 On Aliens (English, Ministry of Interior)
e-Albania: Unique Permit application info

routes.name: Pensioner residence permit
routes.summary: Pensioners are a listed ground for a residence permit in the law.

other: The law lists pensioners but the income rules were not on the pages we could read.
Check with the Border and Migration Police before applying.

sources.label: Law 79/2021 On Aliens (English, Ministry of Interior)

routes.name: Residence permit for property owners
routes.summary: Owning immovable property in Albania is a listed ground for a residence permit.

other: Conditions and any minimum value were not on the pages we could read.

sources.label: Law 79/2021 On Aliens (English, Ministry of Interior)

routes.name: Student residence permit
routes.summary: For students enrolled in Albania. Valid up to a year and renewable until studies end. Graduates can get at least 9 months to look for work.

other: Need proof of enough funds for living costs.
Language requirements may apply.
Tuition and school admission rules not covered here.

sources.label: Law 79/2021 On Aliens (English, Ministry of Interior)

routes.name: Family reunification permit
routes.summary: For spouses, stable cohabiting partners, minor and dependent children of a person legally in Albania. Albanian nationals' families get 1 year, then 2-year renewals.

other: Sponsor needs housing, social insurance and stable income that does not rely on aid.
Family includes a spouse, a proven cohabiting partner, minor or unmarried children, and dependent adult children with health needs.
Not available to family of seasonal workers.
Autonomous permit may be available after 5 years.

sources.label: Law 79/2021 On Aliens (English, Ministry of Interior)

routes.name: Asylum and humanitarian protection
routes.summary: Asylum is handled under Albania's asylum law. Humanitarian and trafficking-victim residence permits also exist.

other: Asylum law text is on the Ministry of Interior site.

sources.label: Law 10/2021 On Asylum (English)
Law 79/2021 On Aliens (English, Ministry of Interior)

routes.name: Permanent residence permit
routes.summary: A permanent permit can be issued after 5 consecutive years of legal stay or on permanent activity. Investors can get it after the second three-year permit.

other: Article 87 with the full conditions was not on the pages we could read.
Naturalization needs a valid permanent permit.

sources.label: Law 79/2021 On Aliens (English, Ministry of Interior)

routes.name: Citizenship by naturalization
routes.summary: 7 years of lawful continuous residence plus a valid permanent permit. Need spoken and written Albanian and basic knowledge of Albanian history.

eligibility.language: Spoken and written Albanian, certified by an authorized school
other: Basic knowledge of Albania's history.
Clean criminal and security record.
Decided by presidential decree. Apply at local State Police.

citizenship.note: Albanian law allows holding other citizenships. Refugees also need 7 years.

sources.label: Law 113/2020 On Citizenship (Albanian, Ministry of Interior)
Albania MFA: citizenship issues

routes.name: Citizenship by marriage
routes.summary: Married to an Albanian citizen for at least 3 years and lawfully resident for at least 1 year. The 7-year rule and language test are waived.

other: Clean criminal and security record.

sources.label: Law 113/2020 On Citizenship (Albanian, Ministry of Interior)
Albania MFA: citizenship issues

routes.name: Citizenship by origin (descent)
routes.summary: Open to people with a direct-line forebear who holds Albanian citizenship, up to three degrees of relation. Former citizens can reacquire it.

other: Direct line only, up to three degrees (for example great-grandparent).
Clean criminal and security record.
Document list is set by ministerial instruction, apply through an Albanian mission or regional police.

sources.label: Law 113/2020 On Citizenship (Albanian, Ministry of Interior)
Albania MFA: citizenship issues

routes.name: Citizenship by birth
routes.summary: A child with at least one Albanian citizen parent is Albanian at birth. A child born in Albania who would otherwise be stateless also gets it.

other: Registration right does not expire at age 18.

sources.label: Law 113/2020 On Citizenship (Albanian, Ministry of Interior)
